name: Auris Health
description: Auris Health, Inc. (originally founded as Auris Surgical Robotics in 2007 by Frederic Moll) was a surgical robotics company headquartered in Redwood City, California, USA. The company developed the [MONARCH](/robot/j&j_monarch) flexible endoluminal bronchoscopy platform and initiated the [OTTAVA](/robot/j&j_ottava) soft-tissue surgical robotics program. In July 2016, Auris acquired intravascular robotics developer [Hansen Medical](/company/hansen_medical), and in April 2019 Auris Health was acquired by [Johnson & Johnson MedTech](/company/johnson_johnson_medtech) for $3.4B upfront.

status.note: Acquired by Johnson & Johnson in April 2019 for $3.4B upfront (plus contingent milestones), integrating MONARCH and OTTAVA into Johnson & Johnson MedTech.
